# KM-142 — Agent join client

**Lane:** agent · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-103, KM-104 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/join.ts`, `packages/agent/src/join.test.ts`

## Outcome

`packages/agent/src/join.ts` is the agent side of the C2 device-code handshake. It has four parts:
1. `parseChannelLink` validates a link and derives the control origin.
2. `requestJoin` calls `POST /api/agent/join`.
3. `pollJoin` polls `GET /api/agent/join/poll?joinId=<joinId>` every 2 s for up to 10 minutes, and returns credentials exactly once.
4. `reportReady` calls `POST /api/agent/join/ready?joinId=<joinId>`.

Failures throw `KhalaClientError`, the shared error from KM-103's `client.ts`. Its code is one KM-143 and KM-144 can surface, and its `message` is a safe reason string. All tests use a fake `fetch` and a fake clock.

The roster says KM-142 "persists `join.json`". KM-143 writes `join.json` itself, from `requestJoin`'s return value plus the link (KM-143 step 3d), so this module does no file I/O.

## Context and evidence

- Plan U12: "Join: request the join, then poll every 2 seconds for up to 10 minutes. Then start the session, report ready…". KTD3 gives the handshake, and R5/R6 the single confirmation. The U12 test says: "A poll that is still pending, then confirmed, then claimed passes through those states in order. Expiry surfaces a typed `join_expired`."
- This ticket pins the exact signatures below and KM-143 consumes them. The server side is KM-131 and KM-133; this ticket codes only to C2.
- The channel link shape comes from `packages/contracts/src/messaging/channel-link.ts`:
  - `:19-21` accepts only `https://<origin>/join/<token>` matching `/^\/join\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,256}$/u`, with no userinfo, query or hash;
  - `:74-75` allows `http:` only for loopback hosts.
  - The agent does not know the deployment origin in advance, so **the control origin is the link's origin**.
- Label rules: C2 says "label 1..40 chars, validateAgentName rules". `validateAgentName` is at `packages/contracts/src/messaging/agent-names.ts:12-20`. It is reachable as `@khala/contracts/messaging/agent-names`, through `packages/contracts/package.json:6` `"./messaging/*"`, and runs under the tsx loader KM-103 chose.

## Scope

`join.ts`, which exports `parseChannelLink`, `requestJoin`, `pollJoin` and `reportReady`, plus `join.test.ts`.

## Non-goals

- Writing `join.json` and `session.json`, starting Matrix, waiting for the invite, and status transitions: KM-143. The Matrix session itself is KM-110. State I/O is KM-141.
- Defaulting the label to `Claude`/`Codex` and mapping errors to MCP results: KM-144.
- Server routes: KM-131, KM-132 and KM-133.

## Contract and invariants

C2, verbatim (including the 2026-10-01 path amendment):

- **Exact paths only.** The control gateway matches exact paths (`apps/control/src/runtime/handler.ts:9-14`), so `joinId` always travels as a query parameter, never as a path segment.
- **Origin header.** Every agent-client POST sends `Origin: <app origin>`, the origin of the channel link. The gateway rejects a POST whose Origin is foreign (`apps/control/src/auth/csrf.ts:14-20`).
- **Confirm URL.** The `confirmUrl` is `<app origin>/agent/confirm?joinId=<joinId>`.

```ts
export type Harness = 'claude' | 'codex';

// POST /api/agent/join            (no auth; rate-limited per IP)
export type AgentJoinRequest = { link: string; harness: Harness; label: string };   // label 1..40 chars, validateAgentName rules
export type AgentJoinCreated = { joinId: string; pollSecret: string; confirmUrl: string; expiresAt: string }; // 201
// errors: 400 invalid_link | invalid_label | invalid_harness ; 404 link_unavailable ; 429 rate_limited

// GET /api/agent/join/poll?joinId=<joinId>      header: Authorization: Bearer <pollSecret>
export type AgentJoinPoll =
  | { state: 'pending' }
  | { state: 'confirmed'; credentials: AgentCredentials }   // returned exactly once
  | { state: 'claimed' }                                     // credentials already taken
  | { state: 'expired' };
// errors: 404 not_found (also for a wrong pollSecret; never 403)

export type AgentCredentials = {
  homeserver: string;      // e.g. "https://127.0.0.1:8443" locally
  userId: string;          // "@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.local"
  accessToken: string;
  deviceId: string;        // "KH_AGENT_<uuid8>"
  roomId: string;          // the channel's Matrix room id
};

// POST /api/agent/join/ready?joinId=<joinId>   header: Authorization: Bearer <pollSecret>
// body: {}  → 204 ; 404 not_found ; 409 not_confirmed
```

"All bodies are JSON. Errors are `{ "error": <code> }` with the HTTP status shown."

C7 `khala_join` errors: `invalid_link`, `link_unavailable`, `join_expired`.

C7 error type, verbatim (KM-103 ships it in `packages/agent/src/client.ts`):

```ts
export type KhalaErrorCode = 'invalid_link' | 'link_unavailable' | 'join_expired' | 'not_connected' | 'send_failed' | 'session_unknown' | 'internal_error';
export class KhalaClientError extends Error { readonly code: KhalaErrorCode; constructor(code: KhalaErrorCode, message?: string) }   // KM-103 ships it
```

This ticket owns the join API below; KM-143 consumes it exactly (its "Interface pins" quote these signatures):

```ts
export function requestJoin(input: { link: string; harness: Harness; label: string }, deps?: { fetch?: typeof fetch }): Promise<AgentJoinCreated & { origin: string }>;
export function pollJoin(input: { origin: string; joinId: string; pollSecret: string }, options?: { intervalMs?: number; timeoutMs?: number; signal?: AbortSignal; fetch?: typeof fetch }): Promise<AgentCredentials>; // throws KhalaClientError('join_expired' | 'link_unavailable')
export function reportReady(input: { origin: string; joinId: string; pollSecret: string }, deps?: { fetch?: typeof fetch }): Promise<void>;
```

Additive exports and options (allowed):
- `parseChannelLink(link: string): { origin: string } | null`;
- `pollJoin` options also accept `sleep?: (ms: number, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>` and `now?: () => number`, for tests.

**Error bodies (Executor ruling).** Two error body shapes reach the client and both must parse: the C2 route body `{ "error": <code> }`, and the control gateway's own body `{ "code": <code>, "requestId": <id> }` (`apps/control/src/runtime/handler.ts:41-42`), which it returns before any route runs: 403 `forbidden_origin` (`:113-114`), 405 `method_not_allowed` (`:112`), 413 `payload_too_large` (`:117`), 404 `not_found` for an unregistered path (`:193`), 503 `feature_unavailable` (`:192`), 500 `internal_error` (`:128,137`). Read the server code as `serverCode = typeof body?.error === 'string' ? body.error : typeof body?.code === 'string' ? body.code : undefined` (a non-JSON body gives `undefined`). Never surface `requestId`.

**Error mapping.** Every throw is `new KhalaClientError(code, reason)`:

| Situation | `code` | `message` (reason) |
|---|---|---|
| `parseChannelLink` null, or server 400 `invalid_link` | `invalid_link` | `invalid_link` |
| Server 404 on request with `serverCode === 'link_unavailable'` | `link_unavailable` | `link_unavailable` |
| Server 404 on request with any other `serverCode` (gateway `not_found`: the deployment lacks the route) | `internal_error` | `route_not_found` |
| Gateway 403 `forbidden_origin`, 405, 413 or 503 on request or ready | `internal_error` | the `serverCode` (`forbidden_origin`, `method_not_allowed`, `payload_too_large`, `feature_unavailable`) |
| Poll `expired`, poll deadline passed, poll `claimed`, or poll 404 | `join_expired` | `expired` \| `timeout` \| `claimed` \| `not_found` |
| Label fails the rules, or server 400 `invalid_label` | `internal_error` | `invalid_label` |
| Server 400 `invalid_harness`, or a bad harness | `internal_error` | `invalid_harness` |
| Server 429 on request | `internal_error` | `rate_limited` |
| A fetch throw on request or ready, or abort during poll | `internal_error` | `network` |
| Ready 404 / 409 | `internal_error` | `ready_not_found` / `not_confirmed` |
| Any other status or malformed body | `internal_error` | `protocol` |

Invariants:
- `pollSecret` and `accessToken` never appear in any error message or log.
- `joinId` travels only as the `joinId` query parameter (`URLSearchParams`), never in the path.
- Both POSTs (`requestJoin` and `reportReady`) send `origin: <link origin>`. The GET sends no Origin header.
- `requestJoin` and `reportReady` make exactly one request; they do no retries.
- Only `pollJoin` tolerates transient failures: a network error, a 5xx or a 429 counts as `pending` until the deadline.

### Files

Create: `packages/agent/src/join.ts` and `packages/agent/src/join.test.ts`.

Modify and delete: nothing.

### Worked example

```
requestJoin({ link: 'https://khala.aiur.team/join/AbCdEfGh12', harness: 'claude', label: 'Claude' })
  → POST https://khala.aiur.team/api/agent/join   content-type: application/json   origin: https://khala.aiur.team
     {"link":"https://khala.aiur.team/join/AbCdEfGh12","harness":"claude","label":"Claude"}
  ← 201 {"joinId":"j_7Qx","pollSecret":"ps_9f","confirmUrl":"https://khala.aiur.team/agent/confirm?joinId=j_7Qx","expiresAt":"2026-10-02T10:10:00.000Z"}
  → returns { joinId:'j_7Qx', pollSecret:'ps_9f', confirmUrl:'https://khala.aiur.team/agent/confirm?joinId=j_7Qx', expiresAt:'2026-10-02T10:10:00.000Z', origin:'https://khala.aiur.team' }

pollJoin({ origin:'https://khala.aiur.team', joinId:'j_7Qx', pollSecret:'ps_9f' })
  → GET https://khala.aiur.team/api/agent/join/poll?joinId=j_7Qx   authorization: Bearer ps_9f   ← 200 {"state":"pending"}
  (sleep 2000)
  → GET …   ← 200 {"state":"confirmed","credentials":{"homeserver":"https://matrix.khala.aiur.team","userId":"@agent-1a2b3c4d-x9y8z7:khala.aiur.team","accessToken":"syt_x","deviceId":"KH_AGENT_0f3a9c21","roomId":"!abc:khala.aiur.team"}}
  → returns the credentials object

reportReady({ origin:'https://khala.aiur.team', joinId:'j_7Qx', pollSecret:'ps_9f' })
  → POST https://khala.aiur.team/api/agent/join/ready?joinId=j_7Qx   authorization: Bearer ps_9f   origin: https://khala.aiur.team   body {}   ← 204
```

### Steps

1. **`parseChannelLink`**
   - `new URL(link)` inside try/catch; a failure → `null`.
   - Require all of: `href === link`; empty `username`, `password`, `search` and `hash`; a `pathname` matching `/^\/join\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,256}$/u`; `link.length <= 2048`.
   - Require `protocol === 'https:'`, or `'http:'` with hostname `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`.
   - Return `{ origin: url.origin }`.
2. **`requestJoin`**, in this order:
   1. Parse the link.
   2. Check the harness is `claude` or `codex`.
   3. Check `validateAgentName(label)` is ok and `[...result.name].length <= 40`. Send `result.name`.
   4. POST with `content-type: application/json` and `origin: <link origin>`.
   5. Map the response through the table.
   6. A 201 body is valid only with these four fields:
      - `joinId` and `pollSecret`: non-empty strings;
      - `confirmUrl`: a URL whose `origin` equals the link origin, with pathname `/agent/confirm`;
      - `expiresAt`: a value where `Date.parse` is finite.
      Otherwise `protocol`.
   7. Return `{ ...body fields, origin }`, with no extra keys.
3. **`pollJoin`**
   1. Defaults: `intervalMs = 2000` and `timeoutMs = 600_000`. `deadline = now() + timeoutMs`.
   2. Loop:
      - If `signal?.aborted` → `network`.
      - GET `<origin>/api/agent/join/poll?joinId=<joinId>` with the bearer.
      - 200 `pending`, a fetch throw, a 5xx or a 429 → continue.
      - 200 `confirmed` with all five credential fields as non-empty strings and a parseable `homeserver` URL → return `credentials`. Missing fields → `protocol`.
      - `claimed`, `expired` or 404 → `join_expired`, with the reason from the table.
      - Any other status, or an unknown `state` → `protocol`.
      - If `now() + intervalMs > deadline` → `join_expired`/`timeout`.
      - Otherwise `await sleep(intervalMs, signal)`.
   3. The default `sleep` uses `setTimeout` and rejects on abort. Map that rejection to `network`.
4. **`reportReady`**: POST `{}` to `<origin>/api/agent/join/ready?joinId=<joinId>` with the bearer, `content-type: application/json` and `origin: <origin>`. 204 → resolve. Otherwise map through the table.

## Test scenarios

`packages/agent/src/join.test.ts`. Use a fake `fetch` that records `{ url, method, headers, body }` and replies from a queue. Use a fake `sleep` and `now` that advance a shared fake clock.

1. **`parseChannelLink`**
   - `https://khala.aiur.team/join/AbCdEfGh12` → `{ origin: 'https://khala.aiur.team' }`.
   - `http://127.0.0.1:8888/join/AbCdEfGh12` → ok.
   - `null` for each of: `http://khala.aiur.team/join/AbCdEfGh12`, `https://x.test/join/short`, `https://x.test/join/AbCdEfGh12?x=1`, `https://u:p@x.test/join/AbCdEfGh12`, `https://x.test/channels/AbCdEfGh12` and `not a url`.
2. `requestJoin` with `https://x.test/channels/AbCdEfGh12` → `KhalaClientError` with code `invalid_link`, and no fetch. (C7 `invalid_link`.)
3. Labels `''`, `'System'`, 41 × `'a'` and `'a\u0007b'` → code `internal_error`, message `invalid_label`, no fetch. `'  Claude  '` is sent as `'Claude'`.
4. The worked example: exact URL, method, headers (including `origin`) and JSON body. The return value deep-equals the example, including `origin`.
5. Request errors:
   - server 400 `{"error":"invalid_link"}` → `invalid_link`;
   - 400 `{"error":"invalid_harness"}` → `internal_error`/`invalid_harness`;
   - 404 `{"error":"link_unavailable"}` → `link_unavailable` (C7);
   - gateway 404 `{"code":"not_found","requestId":"r1"}` → `internal_error`/`route_not_found`;
   - gateway 403 `{"code":"forbidden_origin","requestId":"r1"}` → `internal_error`/`forbidden_origin`; gateway 405 `{"code":"method_not_allowed","requestId":"r1"}` → `internal_error`/`method_not_allowed`; `String(err)` never contains `r1`;
   - 429 → `internal_error`/`rate_limited`;
   - 500 → `internal_error`/`protocol`;
   - a fetch rejection → `internal_error`/`network`.
6. A 201 whose `confirmUrl` is on another origin → `protocol`.
7. **Covers the U12 state order.** Polls return `pending`, `pending`, then `confirmed` → resolves with the credentials. Exactly 3 GETs to `…/api/agent/join/poll?joinId=j_7Qx`, each with `authorization: Bearer ps_9f`, and 2 sleeps of 2000 ms.
8. A poll returning `claimed` → `join_expired`/`claimed`; `expired` → `join_expired`/`expired`; 404 → `join_expired`/`not_found`.
9. A network throw then a 503 while polling, then `confirmed` → resolves.
10. **Deadline.** `timeoutMs: 5000` and every poll `pending` → `join_expired`/`timeout` after 3 GETs (t = 0, 2000, 4000).
11. `confirmed` without `accessToken` → `protocol`.
12. `reportReady`: 204 → resolves; the URL is `…/api/agent/join/ready?joinId=j_7Qx`, with body `'{}'`, the bearer header and `origin`. 409 `{"error":"not_confirmed"}` → `internal_error`/`not_confirmed`. 404 (either body shape) → `internal_error`/`ready_not_found`. Gateway 403 `{"code":"forbidden_origin",…}` → `internal_error`/`forbidden_origin`.
12a. Poll: a gateway 404 `{"code":"not_found","requestId":"r1"}` → `join_expired`/`not_found` (indistinguishable from C2's 404 by design).
13. **Secret hygiene.** For every rejection in scenarios 5–12, `String(err)` contains neither `ps_9f` nor `syt_x`.
14. Aborting `signal` during polling → `internal_error`/`network`, and no further GET.
15. Every thrown value `instanceof KhalaClientError` (imported from `./client`).
16. A `joinId` of `a/b c` is sent as `?joinId=a%2Fb+c`, or the `URLSearchParams` equivalent, and never appears as a path segment.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if KM-104's `agent-join.ts` types differ from the C2 block above, or if KM-103's `client.ts` lacks `KhalaClientError`. Do not define local substitutes.
- KM-143 depends on this ticket and consumes these names; it cannot have merged first. Do not rename them.
- **Stop** if the server (KM-131) uses status codes other than C2's. Report the mismatch; do not widen the mapping.
- Do not add retries to `requestJoin`. The user re-runs `khala_join`.

## Complexity rationale

2: one HTTP state machine with a fixed contract and an error table. Fake-time tests; no I/O beyond `fetch`.
